A Rift-touched worg — an intelligent, malevolent wolf whose pack-bond has been twisted into something darker by Veil exposure. Rift-worgs share a limited psychic link with their packmates, coordinating ambushes with eerie precision. They serve rift-giants and Riftborn warlords, paid in fresh kills and access to Rift pools.
## Traits
**Keen Hearing and Smell.** Advantage on Perception relying on hearing or smell.

## Actions
**Bite.** +5 to hit, 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing. DC 13 STR save or prone.
